name: PopulationOriginsOrAncestryResearchProhibited
summary: The card component of Population Origins or Ancestry Research Prohibited (DUO_0000044). The requester's project intends to use the data for no purpose the owner prohibits, such as population origins or ancestry research, and the requester accepted the terms. Decides about the requester.

prohibitedPurposes.description: Purpose terms, as they appear in IntendedDataUseCredential.useOnlyFor.purposes, that disqualify an IDU: an IDU is usable only if none of its purposes is in this list.
